printf x | grep -qx x
printf x | grep -iq x
printf x | grep -i -q x
printf x | grep -Eq x
printf x | grep -Eqi/ x
printf x | grep --quiet x
printf x | grep --silent x
printf x | grep -m 1 x
printf x | grep -m1 x
printf x | grep --max-count=1 x
printf x | grep --max-count 1 x
printf x | grep x -q
printf x | grep -E 'a|b' -q
printf x | command grep -q x
printf x | egrep -q x
printf x | fgrep -q x
printf x | rg -q x
printf x | /usr/bin/grep -q x
printf x |& grep -q x
printf x |grep -q x
printf x | grep -v y | grep -q x
